about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification by a maker that exports metalworking machinery to more than 70 countries, inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel on every 3-phase machine, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

A hydraulic press presses bearings and bushings, straightens shafts and bends flat bar one part at a time, or runs dies cycle after cycle: bench presses for sheet-metal tooling, workshop and H-frame presses with a brake function, four-column and C-frame presses for dies, presses with a sliding table for straightening, and orbital riveting machines that form rivet heads with a tenth of a press's force.
